interpretation.selectedContent: Active challenge group and highest configured floor/tier on snapshotDate.
interpretation.scenarioLayout: Both sides and all stages/waves are preserved separately; do not flatten different waves into one AoE target group.
interpretation.resistance: Explicit MonsterConfig DamageTypeResistance entries are converted to percent points; an unlisted element is set to 0 only when the same config lists it as a weakness. Incomplete coverage stays flagged.
interpretation.enemyStats: Derived combat stats use Base x MonsterModifyRatio x EliteGroupRatio x StageHardLevelGroupRatio; wave HP multiplier defaults to 0 because no override is present in StageConfig. Toughness is divided by 3 and status resistance adds the stage hard-level value, following the referenced endgame stat processor. Raw factors remain alongside derived values.
interpretation.unmodeledChallengeBuff: challengeBuffId is retained as source data but its effects are not applied by this catalog.
